scope: R-007 minimal MMIO candidate (two read-only loads) stalled on the first trial
probe: step14 EnumaDsiTimingEnabled: exactly two read-only loads 0x0ae6b800 and 0x0ae6c000, no wait, no write

tests.camera_observed: screen uniformly dark with only reflections, matching the two earlier timeout captures

why_this_is_a_stall_and_not_a_refusal: this profile carries the 7 s completion fallback, so a probe returning either the pass or the fail encoding still reaches Android; only a hang inside the read leaves no return at all
main_hypothesis: the stall sits on the first access to the display window, not on probe depth. Five clean stage-10 runs that never touch 0x0ae00000..0x0ae84207 is the contrast case, and a two-load probe failing on its first attempt removes 'too many reads' as an explanation.
state_hypothesis: display-domain reachability varies with the boot sequence rather than with the image. geometry20-control read the same window successfully at 16:38, then five stage-10 runs reset before any display driver executed, and at 17:31 the same window stalled. A plausible mechanism is that the early reset leaves XBL/ABL believing display is already initialised, so the next boot skips that initialisation and the UEFI read lands on an unclocked domain.
discriminating_test: power-cycle the device completely (not a reset), then immediately run the same step14 image once; a clean return supports the boot-sequence hypothesis, a stall at the same point would put it back on the image side
hard_stop: timeout observed for a candidate that no longer contains a long wait or a deep read sequence; no further image was issued
interpretation: 只读两次即挂,读深度不再是解释;第一次触碰显示窗口即挂死,与stage10五笔全干净的对照强烈。当前为硬停,需人工恢复;恢复后先断电冷启动再跑同一镜像以判定启动序列假设。
